comment: Phase 7 batch 3: teacher depth on a matched subset. Both arms train on the same 30,000 positions, the same game-level split, seed and schedule; the only difference is the teacher label (depth 7 vs depth 9). v4_sub30k.json is a deterministic whole-game subset of the clean pool (make_subset seed 51); v4_sub30k_d9.json is that exact file relabelled to depth 9 with the same positions, game ids and category metadata (relabel.py --keep-original). Both are held out from the same records, so either net can be scored against either teacher with eval_labels.py.
